octanoic-acid-pnnl-2017.note: 独立教学解释层；实际位置读取原始 k 数组。宽包络最大值不是纯单模式峰位。

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 先看强羰基带：这一区域符合羧酸 C=O 伸缩。再找宽 O–H 包络；羰基位置也随氢键和结构改变，不能单峰区分所有羧酸。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.labelZh: 羧酸 O–H 宽包络（重叠）
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 观察宽包络而非单一尖峰：羧酸 O–H 与 C–H 伸缩重叠；区间最大值不等于纯 O–H 峰位。结合羰基带判断，不能把最大值直接命名为 O–H 模式。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: maximum of overlapping/broad envelope within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 宽背景上的窄峰主要支持烷基 C–H 伸缩。辛酸同时有长碳链和羧酸；窄峰与宽 O–H 包络可能重叠。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这一指纹区可含羧酸 C–O 伸缩及其他耦合贡献。先用羰基与宽 O–H 建立线索，再把这里作为辅助证据。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这处峰可含长链 CH₂ 和甲基变形。与 C–H 伸缩一起支持烷基骨架，不能据此区分羧酸与酯。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

methyl-acetate-pnnl-2017.note: 独立教学解释层；实际位置读取原始 k 数组。宽包络最大值不是纯单模式峰位。

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这处强带支持酯羰基伸缩。酯与酮的常见区间有所不同，但会受结构影响；再用 C–O 区验证，不能只看一个峰。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.labelZh: 乙酸酯 C–O 相关强带
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里的强带与乙酸酯 C–O 相关振动相符，可能混有骨架耦合。与羰基联合读谱，比只按羰基峰位命名更稳妥。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这一低波数区可能含 C–O 与其他骨架耦合贡献。把它视为辅助指纹，联合较高波数 C–O 带和羰基，不作一峰一键归属。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 观察几处窄峰，支持甲基 C–H 伸缩。很多有机物都出现这些峰；酯的线索还需羰基和 C–O 一起给出。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里的带可支持甲基变形。与甲基伸缩和羰基比较，指纹区中的振动常有耦合，不能据单峰认定乙酸甲酯。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

acetonitrile-pnnl-2017.note: 独立教学解释层；实际位置读取原始 k 数组。宽包络最大值不是纯单模式峰位。

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 先看这处窄带：它支持腈基 C≡N 伸缩。NIST 模式表支持此归属，但气态频率不能直接代替这里的液态实测位置。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: NIST Chemistry WebBook vibrational mode compilation (interpretation only; phase-specific frequencies are not substituted for measured data)

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里的峰支持甲基伸缩；腈旁的甲基环境会影响位置。与 C≡N 带一起看，不按是否超过 3000 cm⁻¹ 单独认定芳香族。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: NIST Chemistry WebBook vibrational mode compilation (interpretation only; phase-specific frequencies are not substituted for measured data)

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这一区域可含甲基对称变形以及组合带影响。联合甲基伸缩和腈带；NIST 对部分模式注明耦合，不能给每峰绝对单一归属。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: NIST Chemistry WebBook vibrational mode compilation (interpretation only; phase-specific frequencies are not substituted for measured data)

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 指纹区这处带与 C–C 伸缩相关模式相符。它只补充骨架证据；先用腈带建立官能团线索，不能仅凭这里鉴定乙腈。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: NIST Chemistry WebBook vibrational mode compilation (interpretation only; phase-specific frequencies are not substituted for measured data)

tert-butylamine-pnnl-2017.note: 独立教学解释层；实际位置读取原始 k 数组。宽包络最大值不是纯单模式峰位。

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 观察 N–H 区较高波数的一处带。伯胺 NH₂ 常有两条伸缩带；再与较低波数 N–H 带联合观察，别被“叔丁”名称误认为叔胺。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 与较高波数的 N–H 带配对阅读，支持 NH₂ 伸缩。液态氢键可改变位置与带宽；双带也要结合 N–H 弯曲区验证。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这处指纹带可含 NH₂ 弯曲，模式可能耦合。与高波数 N–H 双带一起支持伯胺线索，不单凭它区分所有含氮化合物。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 一组窄峰支持叔丁基的 C–H 伸缩。先与上方 N–H 区分，再把两者结合，理解同一分子可含不同官能团证据。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里可含叔丁基甲基变形。它为烷基骨架提供辅助信息，不能代替 N–H 双带来判断胺的类型。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

octane-pnnl-2017.note: 独立教学解释层；实际位置读取原始 k 数组。宽包络最大值不是纯单模式峰位。

teachingPeaks.labelZh: C–H 伸缩峰群：高波数侧
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这组窄峰主要支持烷基 C–H 伸缩。和较低波数侧一起看，先认识峰群，再用变形区补充骨架信息。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.labelZh: C–H 伸缩峰群：低波数侧
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 低波数侧也有 C–H 伸缩贡献，不能把整组峰只命名为一个模式。结合 CH₂/CH₃ 变形，并与含羰基样本比较。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这一区域可含 CH₂ 剪式及甲基变形。与伸缩峰群联合支持烷基骨架；这些振动并非正辛烷独有。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里的带可支持链端甲基变形。把它作为辅助线索，完整指纹和多处比较才能提高结构判断的可信度。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

styrene-pnnl-2017.note: 独立教学解释层；实际位置读取原始 k 数组。宽包络最大值不是纯单模式峰位。

teachingPeaks.labelZh: 乙烯基 C=C 伸缩区
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里的带支持与苯环共轭的乙烯基 C=C 伸缩。位置会受共轭影响；先与末端 =CH₂ 面外带联合，不单凭这一带认定烯烃。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window

teachingPeaks.labelZh: 末端 =CH₂ 面外带：高波数侧
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 约 990 cm⁻¹ 的带可与约 910 cm⁻¹ 的带成对支持末端乙烯基。指纹区可能耦合；要联合 C=C 和 =C–H 区域读谱。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.labelZh: 末端 =CH₂ 面外带：低波数侧
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 与约 990 cm⁻¹ 的带一起观察，支持 R–CH=CH₂ 的面外振动组合。不能把一个低波数指纹峰当作唯一物质鉴定。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.labelZh: sp² C–H 伸缩区（烯基 / 芳香重叠）
teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 一组峰支持 sp² C–H 伸缩；苯乙烯同时含烯基和芳环，二者可重叠。不要把本区最大值全部归给烯基，需再看低波数组合。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里的芳环骨架带说明同一单体还有苯环。与乙烯基特征分开联合观察，不能把苯乙烯与聚苯乙烯低聚物视作同一个样品。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Official university functional-group correlation reference; approximate, qualified interpretation

propyne-nasa-2021-8k.note: 独立教学解释层；实际位置读取原始 k 数组。宽包络最大值不是纯单模式峰位。

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 先看约 3280 cm⁻¹ 的端炔 C–H 带。这里是 8 K 非晶固体，位置和宽度不代表室温气体或液体；再结合 C≡C 与弯曲区。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这处较弱带与论文给出的 C≡C 伸缩相符。三键伸缩可因对称性而很弱或不活跃，不能从缺少强峰否定炔键；本样本须与端炔 C–H 联合判断。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Hudson et al. 2021, Table 8 (amorphous propyne at 8 K); approximate assignments separate from measured k array

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 这里的带可含丙炔 C–H 弯曲贡献，论文归属为近似模式描述。与端炔伸缩和 C≡C 一起读，指纹区通常包含耦合。
teachingPeaks.observedKind: local maximum of raw k within selected window
teachingPeaks.assignmentSource: Hudson et al. 2021, Table 8 (amorphous propyne at 8 K); approximate assignments separate from measured k array

teachingPeaks.explanationZh: 低波数这一带支持端炔 C–H 弯曲。先对照高波数 ≡C–H 伸缩，再联合较弱 C≡C；非晶固体的带形不可套成所有端炔的固定规则。
